theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ μ₀ : Measure (Euclid P)) (z : Euclid P) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → μ₀ = ENNReal.ofReal (r⁻¹ ^ n) • (μ.restrict (ball z (2 * r))).map (dilation z r) → ∀ Λ₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ Λ₀ → (∀ p : Euclid P, (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → μ (ball p ε) ≠ 0) → ∀ σ ρ : ℝ, closedBall p ρ ⊆ closedBall z (2 * r) → 0 < σ → σ < ρ → ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(Λ₀ * σ))) * (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (σ ^ n)) ≤ μ (ball p σ)) → ∀ (x y : Euclid P) (lam ρ : ℝ), 0 < lam → lam ≤ 1 → 0 < ρ → closedBall y ρ ⊆ dilation x lam '' ball 0 2 → (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → (ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) • μ₀.map (dilation x lam)) (ball y ε) ≠ 0) → ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(r * Λ₀ * ρ))) * (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)) ≤ (ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) • μ₀.map (dilation x lam)) (ball y ρ)
